comun.errorGenerico: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact Administration.

login.ayudaContrasena: Forgot or want to change your password?
login.cuentaDadaDeBaja: Your account has been deactivated. Contact Administration.

registro.dniInvalido: The ID number must have 9 characters.
registro.edadMinima: You must be at least 18 to register.
registro.telefonoInvalido: The phone number must include the country code (for example, +34600000000).
registro.correoYaRegistrado: You already have an account with this email. Log in or recover your password.
registro.genericoConPista: We couldn't create the account. Check that the ID number is the one Administration gave you and that you don't already have an account with another email. If the problem continues, contact Administration.

registro.invitacionUsada: That invitation was already used. If you started your registration and didn't finish it, log in with your email and password to confirm the code.

codigo.codigoIncorrectoOVencido: The code is incorrect or expired. Request a new one.

codigo.reenviado: We sent you a new code.
codigo.confirmadoSinSesion: Your email is confirmed, but we couldn't open your session. Please log in with your email and password.

jornadasRecuperadas.mensajeSingular: We found an open shift ({{matricula}}, {{ruta}}) this phone didn't have. You can now view and close it like any other.
jornadasRecuperadas.mensajePlural: We found {{cantidad}} open shifts this phone didn't have. You can now view and close them like any other.

jornadasCorregidas.mensajeSingular: An admin corrected {{campos}} on your shift ({{matricula}}, {{ruta}}).
jornadasCorregidas.mensajePlural: An admin corrected {{cantidad}} of your shifts. Open each one's detail to see what changed.

checkIn.subtituloFormulario: Fill in the details before heading out.
checkIn.errorUbicacionMensaje: Check-in needs to record your current location. Please try again.
checkIn.exitoMensaje: Your check-in was recorded. Have a good trip!
checkIn.errorGenerico: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

checkInForm.fotoHojaRutaAyuda: General backup of the shift's information. Shown in the report if you add it.

checkOut.vacioTexto: Once you start a route, it will show up here so you can close it.

checkOutForm.exitoMensajeSinUbicacion: Your check-out was recorded, but we couldn't capture your location (check your GPS).
